teaser.en: The Digo call this spiny climber 'golden', and one look at its yellow stems shows why.
teaser.sw: Wadigo huuita mtambaa huu wenye miiba 'wa dhahabu', na ukitazama mashina yake ya manjano utaona sababu.

summary.en: *Mdhahabu* is a spiny scrambling shrub of the coastal forest and thicket, named for its golden-yellow stems. It is a wild relative of the figs.
summary.sw: *Mdhahabu* ni kichaka chenye miiba kinachotambaa cha msitu wa pwani na vichaka vizito, kilichopewa jina kutokana na mashina yake ya rangi ya manjano ya dhahabu. Ni jamaa wa porini wa mitini.

about.en:
*Mdhahabu* is a scrambling shrub that leans and climbs through other vegetation, armed with sharp spines. Its most striking feature is the colour of its stems, a clear golden yellow that gives it its name.

It belongs to the fig and mulberry family, and like its relatives it has milky sap.
about.sw:
*Mdhahabu* ni kichaka kinachotambaa ambacho huegemea na kupanda katikati ya mimea mingine, kikiwa na miiba mikali. Sifa yake inayovutia zaidi ni rangi ya mashina yake, manjano ya dhahabu iliyo wazi, inayokipa jina lake.

Ni wa familia ya mitini na mforsadi, na kama jamaa zake kina utomvu kama maziwa.

where.en: Look for *mdhahabu* in coastal forest and thicket, where it scrambles through the undergrowth. The yellow stems are easiest to see where the plant has been cut or the bark scraped.
where.sw: Mtafute *mdhahabu* katika msitu wa pwani na vichaka vizito, ambako hutambaa katikati ya mimea ya chini. Mashina ya manjano ni rahisi zaidi kuonekana mahali ambapo mmea umekatwa au gamba limekwanguliwa.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.

names.en: Digo: *mdhahabu*, meaning 'golden', for its yellow stem. It shares its root with the Swahili word *dhahabu*, gold. No English or Swahili plant name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Maclura africana*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdhahabu*, lenye maana ya 'wa dhahabu', kutokana na shina lake la manjano. Lina mzizi mmoja na neno la Kiswahili *dhahabu*. Hakuna jina la mmea la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi hukiita *Maclura africana*.
